name: Tandoori Chicken Burger Salad with Cucumber Raita, Spinach & Apple
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic.
Add chicken, almond meal, and spices to the bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the chicken mixture into 4 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, trim and coarsely grate cucumber. Use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated cucumber.
Place cucumber in a small bowl, then add yogurt and salt. Whisk to combine the raita and set aside.
Juice limes into in a large bowl. Add oil, honey, and salt; whisk to combine the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Add spinach to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and burger patties between plates or bowls. Top burgers with raita and enjoy!
author: Mealime
